_format: entries newest first; every entry has a version. status "dev" = in development (at most one, first); no status = released. item type: new | improve | fix. zh/en text; `backticks` become <code>.

items.zh: 详情、预览、设置收进左侧“查看器”下面；打开软件直接显示预览，详情和设置改为居中弹出的面板（左上返回、右上关闭），打开时模型的动画和声音不再停止。
items.en: Details, Preview and Settings now sit under Viewer in the left rail; the app opens straight to the preview, and Details and Settings open as a centered panel (back at top left, close at top right) without stopping the model's animation or sound.

items.zh: 详情和设置面板打开时从右往左滑入（先快后慢），关闭时从左往右滑出（先慢后快）。
items.en: The Details and Settings panel now slides in from the right when opened (fast, then easing out) and slides back out to the right when closed (slow, then speeding up).

items.zh: 截图按钮移到右侧工具栏，去掉 3D 视图右下角挡住画面的截图面板和骨骼数显示。
items.en: The screenshot button moved into the right-hand toolbar; the panel in the bottom-right corner of the 3D view that covered the model, along with its bone count, is gone.
